pattern: each {f:Filter} deals damage equal to its power to {to:Recipient}
subject: object

examples.text: Each creature you control that's a Wolf or a Werewolf deals damage equal to its power to target creature you don't control.
Each creature you control that's a Dragon or a Cleric deals damage equal to its power to target creature an opponent controls.

counterExamples: Each creature you control that's a Wolf deals damage equal to its toughness to target creature you don't control.
Each creature you control that's a Wolf deals damage equal to its power to itself.
Each creature you control that's a Wolf deals damage equal to its power to target creature unless it is tapped.
Creatures you control that are Wolves deal damage equal to their power to target creature you don't control.
